request.title: Storm damage in the fabric hall
request.instructions: The thunderstorm last night damaged the roof of the fabric hall. A surveyor has inspected the affected lots (see the quarantine notes in the ERP). Handle the damaged stock: write off what the surveyor declares unusable, release what is usable, and file the incident report for the insurance. Production must not run out of fabric: ask Lara to buy replacement fabric and Cora to re-prioritise the orders.

Cora.text:
# Planning autumn bundles can still end late

Rule: A healthy-looking factory queue and material projection do not guarantee that a large unplanned autumn bundle will finish on time; verify the post-change late-order KPI and material-shortage projection before treating the plan as sufficient.

Applies when: Several confirmed but unplanned sales orders are added together during a campaign spike and no extra capacity lever is booked.

Evidence: task `task-a2a-868119cc-9a29-4881-a984-46c0d33a5118`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-12"}`. Reconfirmed in task `task-a2a-7f936446-e11a-49a9-b9a4-49c7504d3147`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-11"}`. Reconfirmed again in task `task-a2a-0a7827d1-1a0c-4b1b-a2c9-ebe93ff49b49`, KPI before `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `unplannedOrders=8` -> after `lateOrders=8`, `sofasLate=970`, `unplannedOrders=0`, `materialShortages={"FOAM-HR35":"production held back from 2026-11-12"}`.

# North replan after spindle motor delivery

Rule: When `N-CUT-1` is down for the spindle motor replacement, replan only the North orders that are already late if moving additional work would increase the KPI.

Applies when: A North machine outage is tied to `MT-001` and the required part is already secured with a known arrival date.

Evidence: task `task-a2a-7869e423-a373-4844-a249-0c76c2b9dffa`, KPI before `lateOrders=5`, `sofasLate=520`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=5` -> after `lateOrders=2`, `sofasLate=220`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=2`.

- [Log](log.md): append-only session notes for durable company learnings.
- [Planning autumn bundles can still end late](lessons/autumn-bundle-late-even-with-capacity.md): unplanned bundles can still leave all orders late even when current capacity and stock look healthy.
- [North replan after spindle motor delivery](lessons/north-replan-spindle-motor.md): what we learned about re-planning North orders after the spindle motor arrives.

Tom.text:
# Warehouse Damage Disposition

Rule: When a surveyor has split a damaged lot into unusable and usable quantities, the warehouse must write off the unusable part and release only the usable part.

Applies when: Quarantined stock has an inspection note that gives a concrete usable/unusable split.

Evidence: task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ, KPI 8 late orders / 760 sofas late / 8 late without notice -> 2 late orders / 120 sofas late / 2 late without notice.

# Storm Damage Playbook

Rule: Handle storm-damaged stock in the order surveyor note, write off only the unusable quantity, release only the usable quantity, and file the insurance incident report after the warehouse disposition.

Applies when: A weather incident damages warehouse stock and the lots are quarantined for inspection.

Evidence: task task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ, KPI 8 late orders / 760 sofas late / 8 late without notice -> 2 late orders / 120 sofas late / 2 late without notice.

Steps:
1. Read the quarantine note and confirm the surveyor quantities.
2. Write off the unusable quantity from each affected lot.
3. Release the usable quantity from each affected lot.
4. File the incident report for insurance with the surveyor-backed loss estimate.
5. Hand off procurement and planning so fabric shortages are covered and production is re-prioritised.

- [Storm damage playbook](playbooks/storm-damage.md): sequence for quarantined material after storm damage, including write-off, release, incident report, and follow-up handoffs.
- [Warehouse handling rule](lessons/warehouse-damage-disposition.md): release only the surveyor-approved usable quantity and write off only the declared unusable quantity.
- [Run log](log.md): append-only record of learned facts from warehouse incidents.

Surveyor-verified storm damage split two quarantined fabric lots into unusable and usable quantities. The warehouse disposition reduced the active shortage picture, and the remaining follow-up is procurement/planning for `FAB-ANTH-02`.

# Goal
Re-prioritise the scoped fabric-affected production orders only if that reduces late orders without creating new ones. The current ERP state shows the fabric issue on `FAB-ANTH-02` is still present, but all eight scoped orders are currently on time, so the decision is whether any queue change is justified at all.

# Inputs
- Live ERP overview: `lateOrders=0`, `sofasLate=0`, `lateOrdersCustomerNotInformed=0`, `unplannedOrders=[]`, `costOfMeasuresEur=87,720`.
- Scoped orders and current dates from ERP: `PRD-4201`, `PRD-4204`, `PRD-4205`, `PRD-4209`, `PRD-4210`, `PRD-4213`, `PRD-4216`, `PRD-4217` are all currently `daysLate=0` with expected delivery dates between `2026-10-10` and `2026-10-25`.
- Material projection for `FAB-ANTH-02`: `usableNow=1700`, open PO `PO-4430` ETA `2026-10-15`, first shortage `production is held back from 2026-10-13`.
- Capacity checks: both factories show `40 sofas/day` for the next 10 workdays, with all machines running and no worker absences.
- Relevant wiki: `index.md`, `protocols/handoffs.md`, `protocols/ordered-delegation.md`, `rules/customer-notices.md`, `rules/capacity-levers.md`, `lessons/autumn-bundle-late-even-with-capacity.md`, `lessons/north-replan-spindle-motor.md`.

# Steps
1. Keep the existing priority-5 queue unchanged; do not move any of the scoped orders unless a better simulation appears.

3. If execution is approved, carry out no `update_production_order` calls and then verify the ERP late-order list remains empty for the scoped orders.

- If the live ERP state changes again before execution, the recommendation may need to be revalidated.

tasks.plan:
# Goal
Handle the storm-damaged fabric inventory so the surveyor's unusable stock is written off, usable stock is released back into production, the insurer gets a claim report, and procurement/planning are pulled in so fabric shortages do not worsen.

# Inputs
- Simulation date: 2026-10-05.
- Quarantined lots in the fabric hall:
  - `L-OAT-231` / `FAB-OAT-01`: 9,000 m total, with surveyor note saying 7,200 m unusable and 1,800 m usable.
  - `L-ANTH-219` / `FAB-ANTH-02`: 8,500 m total, with surveyor note saying 6,800 m unusable and 1,700 m usable.
- Current KPI before any change: 8 late orders, 760 sofas late, 8 late without customer notice, shortages on `FAB-ANTH-02` from 2026-10-05 and `FAB-OAT-01` from 2026-10-15.
- What-if result for the full warehouse disposition (`write_off_stock` + `release_stock` on both lots): KPI improves from 8 late orders / 760 sofas late / 8 late without notice to 2 late orders / 120 sofas late / 2 late without notice; the remaining shortage is only `FAB-ANTH-02` from 2026-10-13.
- What-if result for write-off only: no KPI improvement.
- What-if result for release only: the same KPI improvement as the full warehouse disposition, but it leaves the damaged material unaccounted for, so it is not the right final action.
- Supplier facts from the company wiki: Tuchwerk Bielefeld AG supplies both fabrics; express lead time is 8 workdays; Tessile Como supplies only `FAB-OAT-01`.
- Company wiki pages read: `index.md`, `protocols/handoffs.md`, `protocols/ordered-delegation.md`, `rules/customer-notices.md`, `suppliers/overview.md`.

# Steps
1. Execute `write_off_stock` for `lotId: L-OAT-231`, `quantity: 7200`, `reason: Surveyor report 2026-10-05 after storm damage: water-damaged, mould risk, unusable.`
2. Execute `release_stock` for `lotId: L-OAT-231`, `quantity: 1800`, `note: Surveyor report 2026-10-05: dry and usable after storm inspection.`
3. Execute `write_off_stock` for `lotId: L-ANTH-219`, `quantity: 6800`, `reason: Surveyor report 2026-10-05 after storm damage: water-damaged, mould risk, unusable.`
4. Execute `release_stock` for `lotId: L-ANTH-219`, `quantity: 1700`, `note: Surveyor report 2026-10-05: dry and usable after storm inspection.`
5. Execute `file_incident_report` with `type: storm_damage`, `description: Thunderstorm last night damaged the roof of the fabric hall; surveyor inspection on 2026-10-05 split the two quarantined lots into unusable and usable portions.`, `estimatedLossEur: 165200`.
6. Delegate to Lara (`sofa-lara`) to buy replacement fabric for the remaining anthracite shortage: `FAB-ANTH-02`, quantity `6800`, needed by `2026-10-13`, using `Tuchwerk Bielefeld AG` and express delivery if she can secure it, because production is held back from 2026-10-13 after the warehouse correction.
7. Delegate to Cora (`sofa-cora`) to re-prioritise the fabric-affected production orders after the warehouse correction and procurement date is known: `PRD-4201`, `PRD-4204`, `PRD-4205`, `PRD-4209`, `PRD-4210`, `PRD-4213`, `PRD-4216`, `PRD-4217`; keep existing priority 5 orders intact unless she can reduce late orders without creating new ones.
8. Update the wiki after execution with the learned durable rule and the incident playbook that stay true for the company, and append the run to the log. The pages expected to change are the local wiki files under `wiki/` and any company wiki proposal that turns out to be durable.

Rejected options:
- Write-off only: rejected because the simulation showed no KPI improvement.
- Release-only: rejected because it leaves the damaged stock disposition incomplete even though the KPI improves.

# Outputs
- `.agent/plans/task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ.md`
- `.agent/summaries/task-01M61EDVJV0QJWHEAKH8WR1XCJ_plan_1.md`

# Risks and open questions
- The plan assumes the surveyor note is the final basis for both write-off and release quantities.
- The procurement request to Lara may still need refinement in execution if the remaining shortage window changes after her sourcing answer.
- The Cora handoff depends on the actual dates returned after procurement and may need to be sequenced after Lara’s result.
- The incident report cost estimate is based on the write-off values from the simulation.

tasks.plan:
# Goal
Buy 6,800 m of `FAB-ANTH-02` to replace the storm-damaged fabric in the hall, using the company-preferred supplier `S-TUCHWERK` (Tuchwerk Bielefeld AG). Use express delivery because the normal lead time does not help with the shortage date and the express option is the only one that materially improves the KPI.

# Inputs
- Simulation date: `2026-10-05`.
- Surveyor result for lot `L-ANTH-219` / `FAB-ANTH-02`: 6,800 m unusable and 1,700 m usable.
- ERP inventory confirms `FAB-ANTH-02` usable stock is 1,700 m and the shortage starts `2026-10-13`.
- Supplier lookup: `S-TUCHWERK` supplies `FAB-ANTH-02`, has lead time 12 workdays, express lead time 8 workdays, minimum order 1,000 m, maximum order 30,000 m, unit price 11.8 EUR, express surcharge 1.1 EUR per unit.
- What-if before you propose: a standard PO for 6,800 m would arrive `2026-10-21` and leaves KPI at late orders 1 / sofas late 70 / late without notice 1 / cost 80,240 EUR. An express PO for 6,800 m would arrive `2026-10-15` and improves KPI to late orders 0 / sofas late 0 / late without notice 0 / cost 87,720 EUR.
- Wiki: `suppliers/overview.md` (Tuchwerk is the main supplier for both fabrics and offers express), `protocols/handoffs.md` (procurement request needs SKU, quantity, needed-by date, reason, and current KPI), `protocols/ordered-delegation.md` (dependency order only; no dependent work is needed here), `entities/s-foamtec.md` (read as a comparable supplier fact page; not directly applicable to this SKU).

# Steps
1. Create one purchase order with `gateway_erp__create_purchase_order` using `supplierId: "S-TUCHWERK"`, `sku: "FAB-ANTH-02"`, `quantity: 6800`, `express: true`, and a note referencing the storm damage and the split lot `L-ANTH-219`.
2. Verify the returned PO id, supplier, ETA, and cost; then confirm the KPI after the change with `gateway_erp__get_kpi` and `gateway_erp__get_material_projection` for `FAB-ANTH-02`.
3. Update the task wiki and write the report with the PO id(s), supplier, delivery date, total cost, and KPI after.

# Outputs
- `.agent/summaries/task-a2a-b4c16eb6-adeb-46c9-8374-9387e770e33c_plan_1.md`
- `wiki/log.md`
- `wiki/index.md`
- Relevant wiki page(s) under `wiki/` if a durable rule is learned

# Risks and open questions
- Express delivery still may not fully eliminate the material-shortage note on the projection page, even though it improves the KPI; the approval decision is whether the improved KPI justifies the surcharge.
- The supplier’s exact PO id and ETA will only be known after execution.
- No follow-up colleague task is needed unless the approved execution reveals an unexpected constraint.
